name: Pocket Diary, Bound
tagline: The family's pocket diary, bound: one steel line of time lit from Now to Next and wired into the plan it reports, diary-set dates, unboxed pages, and back pages tabbed in grounded colour.
concept: The family's pocket diary, bound into spreads. Every page, Chat now included, hangs from one 2px steel line. Its stops are rings: a lit Now lamp, a breathing Next ring, Due and Later. The line ends at the machine's own last stop above the footer. Light follows wiring. On Home and Plans the line is lit only from Now to the next plan. On Home the green Next-up screen ends level with Coming up's head, so its socket drops one short lit lead (about 38px) onto the readout of the row it reports. What the family wrote stays matte, under unboxed rule heads.
companions:
The amber rings are gone from the line, and grounded colours took their share. The back pages and the Settings cells carry 6px thumb-index tabs, about 56px wide, and each hue now means one kind of page on both Home and Settings:
- Sage #8fa58c: what is kept and said (Memory, Messages, What has changed).
- Steel-blue #7f9bb5: the people and who signs in (Family, Personality and family, Sign-in and security).
- Wheat #c9b27e: the machine and its cost (Status, AI model, Spending, Lookups).
- Slate-lilac #9a93b8: the house and its wiring (Settings, General, Connections).

Each back-page icon takes its tab's hue. A muted oxblood #8c4f45 ribbon hangs under the current place in the bar, or over the current tab on the phone. Amber is kept for one half-lamp per late group and for the late words. The plans' cyan stays in the diary months. The kinds keep their terracotta, sage and steel-blue wells.
decisions: Home row A rebuilt so the lead is the gap and nothing more. The left page is her tab, the box, the starters and then Coming up's rule head, whose rule stops at the gutter. The right page is the setup line on top, then the tube, pushed down so its foot is level with that head. The Next row follows 1rem below. The socket sits on the tube's bottom bezel, and the lead is drawn by the Next row itself (li.is-next::after, its top at -var(--ab)). Its length comes from the layout, not from a hand-tuned property. It is about 38px, crosses no rule and lands on 'in 2 days'.

I bent the brief: the setup line sits ABOVE the tube on the right page, not under it. Under the tube it would sit across the lead's path or push the tube's foot away from its row. Above, it fills the hole beside the box with content, and the screen stays wired straight to the row it reports. It is two lines: 'Finish setting up 3' with 'All 3 steps' at the right, then 'Choose your own password →'. No separator dangles.
The lit run is the spread's height plus the gap, so it ends exactly at the breathing Next ring on any content.

Plans carries the line's grammar. The rings are gone from the week heads (the week is now a quiet 13px mono label), so rings sit only on dated rows. The line is lit with the kit's halo from today's lamp to the next plan's ring, which breathes as Home's does. Only that row's readout glows; the others are label grey.

Chat hangs from the left line too. The title's line runs to the terminus, and each day break is a 10px ring on the line with a hairline rule running into the centred diary numeral. The centre spine stays as the conversation's own thread and ends at the Now box.

The terminus no longer claims 'Ready'. The lit state says 'Answering', which is what the lamp reports (web/status.light). An amber half-lamp with 'needs a look' still appears while a trouble goes on, and a red ring with 'Not answering' when the bot cannot answer.

Lately added and Ideas: the kind and who it is for follow the title as one 14px ink-2 run ('Activity · for Maya, Theo'). Ideas drops its separate For column, and the #n at the far right is the only right-hand figure on Home.

'Where I am' is one 44px crosshair toggle: a real checkbox, visually hidden, inside its label, the same on every screen. On the phone it sits inside the textarea's right edge, as an attach key does in a messenger. That leaves From, mic and Send on one row, so 'who is asking?' is never clipped and the box loses a row.
Links in heads and rows (rule-head counts, 'All 3 steps', To do's per-row Edit, Status →) carry no underline at rest and underline on hover or focus. Running text and the setup link keep theirs.
The phone hides the stop words. The lamp and rings carry the line there, and the sideways 'Now' tag is gone.

Settings cells: tabs at 6px by 3.5rem, hues keyed by section name (sc-<name> class), a min-height so the rows read nearly level, and the 'Needs a look' tag unboxed again as amber words after a half-lamp.

Sheet: I pruned dead rules found by a coverage pass. I ran every page at 1280 and 390 wide (Home, Chat, Ideas, an idea, the form, Restaurants, Plans and the month, To do in three states, Wishes, Family, Memory, Status, Settings and all nine sections, Setup, You, 404, sign-in), with details opened, and removed only selectors that matched nothing and are not state-dependent. Also removed: the old settings-as-rows layer and the hand-tuned lead. The sheet is 199.1K of the 200K budget.
title: 'Jot it down for *plan*.' as before: 'Jot it down for Vera to *plan*.', with the full stop outside the glow and the three-layer halo on 'plan'. On the phone it is held to 'Jot it down / for Vera to plan.' with text-wrap: balance. It says FamilyDB's job in the diary's own voice: you jot something down, in a diary, for Vera to turn into a plan. The lit word comes last, and 'something' can be a plan, an idea or a reminder.
measures:
The full render passes: 0 hard checks failed. The one guideline missed is words changed (plans 72.2%, the inherited diary wording).
- Contrast: ink_on_bg 13.41:1, brand_on_bg 15.2:1.
- Green share of colour: home 68.4% (was 69.8%), ideas 73.3%, chat 74.9%, status 34.6%.
- Hue entropy: home 0.534 (was 0.515), ideas 0.43, chat 0.486, status 0.6.
- Smallest text is 13px on every page. No sideways scroll on any page.
- Targets under 44px: Home 3 (1 under 24), against 4 before; Ideas, Plans, To do, the form and General 0; Status 2; Settings 1; Chat 1.
- CIEDE2000 minimum gaps: sections 12.2 typical / 6.6 deutan / 7.4 protan; kinds 15.8 / 6.6 / 9.0.
- Lead about 38px, from the socket at y≈478 to the readout at y≈516 (desktop full page). On the phone, NEXT UP is at y≈383 CSS px.
strengths: The tube is now wired to its row by a short straight lead. The Coming up head stops at the gutter and the tube's foot sits on the row gap, so the lead reads as a cable plugged into the readout, not as a wire stretched across ground. The lit run from the Now lamp ends exactly at the breathing Next ring.
No dead column beside the box. The right page holds the setup line and then the screen, and the whole first screen is content.

The line's grammar now holds on every dated page. Plans has a lit run from today to the next plan with a breathing ring and rings only on dated rows. Chat hangs from the left line with day rings and ends at the terminus. Home, To do, Status, Settings and the form already did.
The terminus tells the truth ('Answering', or an amber half-lamp with 'needs a look'), and the line ends at it on every page.

Grounded colour has a system: four tab hues, each meaning one kind of page, the same on Home's back pages and in Settings, with the back-page icons in their tab's hue. The oxblood ribbon marks where you are.

Typesetting: the kind and owner are one quiet run after the title on Home and Ideas, so the eye reads title then facts with no 250px gutter. Counts sit on the title's baseline. Diary numerals are tabular Plex Sans Light. Links in heads stop being underlined at rest.
On the phone, From, mic and Send fit on one row, with the crosshair toggle inside the field. The box is shorter and the tube sits higher.
weaknesses: Green share on Home is still 68.4%, above the ~60% target. The box's lit wash, the tube, Send and Add, the lit run and the lead are all phosphor by design. I lowered the readouts but did not dim the box's resting glow, which the owner asked to bring back.

With the setup line above it, the tube's top sits about 115px below the box's top on desktop. With no setup steps left, the right page's top stays empty above the tube: it is aligned to the foot, so that its lead stays short. I did not render that state.

The Plans lit run assumes the next plan is the row directly after today's within the same week. A next plan in a later week gets no lit run, only today's lamp. It also assumes the two rows are about the same height.
Settings cells hold a min-height of 8.75rem, so the first two rows have some empty ground under short states, and Connections is still a little taller.
The terminus cannot see the setup or Settings 'Needs a look' states (only the alerts light), so 'Answering' is honest but says nothing of the unfinished password.
The sheet is at 199.1K of 200K. The brief's 170K was not reached: the coverage pass found little true dead weight, because most unmatched selectors are state-dependent.
Ideas loses its For column header. Who an idea is for now sits in the quiet run after the kind, which is less scannable as a column.
revisions: Lead fixed. The Coming up head moved into the left page, its rule stopping at the gutter. The tube is aligned to the spread's foot and the rows follow 1rem under it. The lead is li.is-next::after, its length taken from the layout (--ab plus half the row). The old .lead span and --lead-h are deleted, and the lit run was re-derived the same way.
The hole beside the tube is filled. The setup line moved to the right page, as two lines above the tube rather than under it (see decisions for why the brief was bent).
Terminus truth: 'Ready' became 'Answering'. The amber half-lamp and 'needs a look' state is kept for troubles.

Plans: week-head rings and connectors removed and weeks set as quiet labels; the line is lit from today's lamp to the next plan's breathing ring; readouts are label grey except the next plan's, which glows.
Chat: the left line now runs from the title to the terminus, with a 10px ring and a hairline rule at each day break.
Lately added and Ideas: kind and for are one 14px ink-2 run after the title, and the For column is removed.

Colour: the back-page icons take their tab hue (the rule was there but lost; it is now explicit). Settings tabs are keyed by section name to the same four meanings as the back pages, and each tab is 6px by 3.5rem.

Phone: the crosshair toggle sits inside the textarea's right edge, and From, mic and Send share one row. The setup line is two clean lines. The stop words are hidden. Coming up's head follows the setup line.

Controls: one 44px crosshair toggle on desktop and phone. No underline at rest on head links, 'All 3 steps' or To do's per-row Edit. The 'All 3 steps' summary is a 44px target with a negative margin, so it stays compact.
Settings cells: min-height so the rows read nearly level, and the 'Needs a look' tag unboxed.
Sheet pruned with a coverage pass over every page at both widths, plus the old settings-rows layer.
Declined: setting the week as a stop word in the line's margin on Plans, because '28 Sep – 4 Oct' does not fit the 90px margin. It is a quiet label in the column instead, with no ring.
Declined: putting the setup line under the tube. That would either cross the lead or move the tube's foot away from the row it reports, and the lead being short is the critic's first fix.
Declined: lowering the box's resting glow to cut the green share. The owner asked for the original light back, and that glow is part of it.
crit: Home, THE LEAD (.bound --lead-h:12.1rem, the lead under .next-up): it is about 200px, it crosses the Coming up rule head, and it lands on the 'in 2 days' readout from above through the heading. It reads as a wire stretched across a gap, which is exactly the fault Listing's stem was marked down for. Bring Coming up up so the tube's foot sits about 40px over the Next row. Either let the setup line and starters sit in the left page only and start Row B directly under the tube (align-self:end on the tube, or move the 'Finish setting up' line under the starters with the tube grown to the left page's height so its bottom bezel is the row gap), or put the Coming up rule head's title and count in the left 1fr only and stop its rule before the 380px column. Then the lead never crosses a rule. Derive the length from layout (place the socket on the tube's bottom and the lead as the row's ::before with top:-gap), not a hand-tuned custom property.

Home, the hole beside the tube: the right page ends at about y=365 while the left page (box, starters, setup) runs to about 460, leaving a dead 380px column that only the lead crosses. Fill it with content, don't stretch it. Either move the setup line ('Finish setting up 3 · Choose your own password → · All 3 steps', with its short amber tick) under the tube on the right page as the brief asked (now it is on the left), or set the tube's caption strip ('Next four weeks · weekends shaded') plus the next two plan names as tube text. Right now the setup line sits on the left page under the starters, which is the wrong page for the brief.

Terminus truth (base.html terminus(status_light, status_words), .t-look and .half-lamp): Settings shows 'Sign-in and security · Needs a look' and the Status head says '1 needs a look', yet every page's terminus reads 'Ready' with a fully lit lamp. The one stop that reports the machine contradicts the page. Feed the same trouble count Status uses into status_light so the state becomes 'part' (amber half-lamp plus 'needs a look'), or word the lit state 'Answering' so it does not claim everything is fine.

Carry the lit run onto the other dated pages. On Plans the today row has a lit lamp, but the steel line from 2 Oct to the 4 Oct Oaks Park row is unlit, and the week-head rings plus row rings make a ring every about 50px. Light the line from today's lamp to the next plan's ring with the same halo, as on Home. Drop the rings on the week heads (set the week as a small 13px stop word in the line, like Now/Next) so rings stay only on dated rows; on To do, likewise, light the line from the Now rule to... nothing undated, so keep it steel there. Chat has no main line at x≈90 at all (only the centre spine), so the 'same line everywhere' idea breaks there. Hang the title and the day break from the left line, or at least end the centre spine at the Now box with the terminus.

Lately added and Ideas, the 'for' column (.home Lately rows, ideas table): on Home the kind sits at x≈425 and 'for' at x≈545, about 250px from short titles. On Ideas 'For' is a separate column at x≈538 with a wide empty gutter. The brief said to bring 'for' beside the titles. Set kind and for as one 14px ink-2 meta run right after the title ('Activity · for Maya, Theo'), or narrow the grid to minmax(12rem,auto) 7rem 1fr so the columns close up. Then the #n column at the far right is the only right-hand figure.

Colour share: green measures 69.8%, above the about-60% target, mostly from the lit run, the lead, Coming up's 'in N days' readouts and Plans' green readouts on every row. Keep the phosphor only on the Next row's 'in 2 days' and set the other rows' readouts in ink-2 (they are already grey on Home; on Plans .day-row readouts are still green-tinted). Give the back-page icons their tab's hue as the brief promised (Memory sage, Family steel-blue, Status wheat, Settings lilac): now they are ink. On Settings, key each cell's tab hue to its section consistently with the back pages (Spending is lilac here, and Settings is lilac on Home).

Phone Home: 'Where I am' takes a full row of its own under the From/mic/Send row, so the box runs to y≈800 (CSS ≈400). Put the 44px crosshair toggle in the From row (select flex:1, crosshair, mic, Send). The setup line's 'Choose your own password' wraps and falls under the tab strip with its separator '·' dangling after '3': set it as two lines ('Finish setting up 3' / 'Choose your own password →') with no trailing dot. The vertical rotated 'Now' word on the line reads as a sideways glow tag; set it horizontal at 13px left of the lamp, or drop it on the phone.

Controls and targets: on desktop the 'Where I am' checkbox is about 20px and the label is not one 44px target (wrap the checkbox, crosshair and words in one label with min-height:2.75rem). To do's 'Edit' links and Home's 'All 3 steps', '3 late' and 'All plans' are underlined at rest in every row. Keep the underline for the page-level links and drop it on the per-row 'Edit' (icon plus words, underline on hover/focus). Settings cells: the tabs are 44×4px, too faint to read as thumb-index tabs; make them 6px tall and about 56px wide as briefed, and give the cells min-height so 'Connections' does not make its row taller than the rest.

firstDraft.name: Pocket Diary, Bound
firstDraft.concept: The family's pocket diary, bound into spreads. Every page hangs from one 2px steel line. Its stops are rings: a lit Now lamp, a breathing Next ring, Due and Later, each with its word small in the margin. The line ends at the machine's own last stop above the footer. Light follows wiring: the line is phosphor only from the Now lamp to the Next ring, and one straight lit lead drops from a socket on the green screen onto the readout of the row it reports. Everything the family wrote stays matte, on unboxed rule heads.
